analysis: Format: static ad with large headline on white top band, hero product photo centered, bottom claim line. Family: before/after-ish testimonial claim but no split screen; product-led. Mechanism zone = product label copy and implied function. Role of zones: top headline = avatar pain/desire in first person; middle = product proof/hero; bottom = concise outcome/CTA-style claim. Rival/ours: none (single-product template). Before/after = before chronic exhaustion vs after 3 days/7-day change. Pain/desire = exhaustion and wanting renewed energy; rewritten for heavy swollen legs and lighter legs by evening.
